latest_release.name: OpenIDEA v0.1.43
latest_release.body:
OpenIDEA 0.1.43 adds an allocation and live-object profiler for JVM runs, FTP/FTPS deployment, Django templates, notebook code intelligence, custom ACP agents with a command policy, Kotlin debugging, Bun debugging, run configuration folders in Services and a custom local data directory, and ships Plugin API 1.6.

### Download

**Remote development:** `openidea-server` for [Linux x86-64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.43/openidea-server-linux-x86_64.gz) · [Linux ARM64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.43/openidea-server-linux-aarch64.gz) · [macOS x86-64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.43/openidea-server-macos-x86_64.gz) · [macOS ARM64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.43/openidea-server-macos-aarch64.gz), each with a `.sha256` file.

**Already installed?** OpenIDEA updates itself: use **Check for Updates**.

## What's new

### Run, debug and profile
- **Profiler** for JVM runs: allocations and live objects.
- Debug Kotlin with kotlin-lsp's debugger, and Bun files with bun-dap; a Bun run configuration type.
- Each test's console output in the test tree, and a group's when it is selected; Run and Debug consoles show output again where they had stopped.
- Services group run configurations by their folders, with Run / Restart / Stop All per folder, and show only the services you added.
- Java: Delegate IDE build/run actions to Maven; jdtls imports Gradle builds with the build settings and on the IDE's Gradle JVM; Maven build plugins that don't resolve are explained; compile builds skip JaCoCo instrumentation.
- Tomcat rebuilds the WAR when web resources or dependency modules change; Delve offers to reinstall when it is too old, and its build output is cleaned up.

### Languages and editor
- **Django templates**, and completion, hover, diagnostics and navigation in **notebook cells**.
- Kotlin: kmp-lsp as an alternative language server. Go: upgrades, vulnerabilities and deprecated modules when `go.mod` opens.
- Java `.var` introduces a variable of the expression's type; JavaDoc text is coloured as a doc comment; navigation and usages resolve against the text just typed.
- Code vision position per hint and a "no usages" switch; implementation gutter icons for the whole file; `<>` pairs where a generic type list starts; add and remove a UTF-8 BOM; a chosen

detail.readme:
The IDE you know, rebuilt in Rust.

Download  ·  Docs  ·  Benchmark  ·  Plugins  ·  Community  ·  Sponsor

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/234dd54c-1255-4b3a-b35c-533d78d737c0 OpenIDEA brings the IntelliJ IDEA way of working — its keymap, its tool windows, its search-everything habits — to a native app with a Rust core. Editor, code insight, debugger, Git, terminal, database and HTTP clients, for 60+ languages. Builds for macOS, Windows and Linux. ## Benchmark Opening [freqtrade](https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade) (Python, ~770 files) with warm caches, median of 5 runs: | | OpenIDEA | IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3 | | --------------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------- | | Window with the project | **0.9 s** | 3.1 s | | Ready (CPU settled) | **1.1 s** | 13.2 s | | Memory (USS, all processes) | **169 MB** | 2011 MB | | CPU time until ready | **2.4 s** | 47.9 s | | Idle CPU | **4 %** of a core | 7 % of a core | | Quit | **0.3 s** | 5.9 s | A release build of OpenIDEA from `main` and IDEA with default settings and plugins, on Windows 11, 32-core AMD, 62 GB RAM. IDEA analyses Python more deeply, so "ready" doesn't mean the same work on both sides. Both are measured from the outside, the same way: see [`perf/compare`](perf/compare) to run it on your machine and projects. ## Plugins Plugins add actions, completion, quick fixes, tool windows, custom editors, themes, file icons and languages. They run as sandboxed WebAssembly components; themes, icon themes and languages need no code at all. Install them from Settings › Plugins, or start your own with `openidea-plugin new` — see [Writing OpenIDEA plugins](https://openidea.sh/en/plugins) and the [official plugins](plugins/official). The plugin API is still a preview. ## Community - [Discord](https://discord.gg/2Zy4yn7gP) — questions, feedback and release news. - WeChat group — scan to join: - Contributing: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [contributor docs](https://openidea.sh/en/contribute/setup). ## Sponsor If OpenIDEA saves you time, you can support its development with Alipay or WeChat Pay.
